trackC.claimRules: LLP 0064 exactly: Contract/web claims only what its provider and acceptance receipt prove; exact-native/ios and exact-native/android are independent profiles; an Online result does not imply local-first Parity; Parity requires generated local execution, retained reads, a durable ordered queue, replay/rebase, authority fencing, reconnect convergence, and release-artifact exclusion of server implementation.
trackC.unreadyRule: If the Exact Native surface is not ready when the sweep completes, Track C records an honest program GAP and remains a separate successor gate; the sweep report is never delayed for it. No polling gateway, Contract-on-Hermes instrument, or React Native carrier substitutes for an Exact Native profile.
